subject.title: ci: add weekly dependabot updates and CI autofix workflow

question: Should the new Dependabot autofix workflow run privileged install/autofix steps for any same-repo dependabot/* branch, or must it be restricted to Dependabot-authored PRs before merge?
rationale: This changes the repository's automation security boundary by combining workflow_run, a write token, AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY, dependency installation, and branch-prefix routing.

options.title: Restrict to Dependabot actor
options.body: Require Dependabot identity before checkout/install/autofix and refresh the shared CI script against current dev before merging.

options.title: Accept private-repo branch-prefix risk
options.body: Merge with the current same-repo dependabot/* gate and own the risk that trusted branch creators can trigger the privileged path.

options.title: Pause for live rollout proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until a maintainer can stage or prove the workflow behavior without weakening the CI gate.

recommendation.title: Restrict to Dependabot actor
recommendation.body: Require Dependabot identity before checkout/install/autofix and refresh the shared CI script against current dev before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: Javier has the strongest recent CI/workflow history and already reviewed the exact privileged workflow concerns.
